inbodydescription.para: NOTE: Zero value here describes invalid/negative state. Make sure TempMax and TempThreshold are non-zero and trigger an action if threshold is crossed

briefdescription.para: This function is used to start the task which enables HBM temperature monitoring in PLM.

detaileddescription.para: This will only work on the devices with HBM nodes present in the topology. If the feature is not enabled for any of the HBM stacks (controlled through PLM RTCA), then the task is never started. During the task execution, if found that no HBM stacks are configured in the design, then it is removed from the task queue.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful, return error code otherwise

briefdescription.para: This function checks whether DRAMs are in self-refresh mode.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if at least one DDRMC is enabled in the design and all the active DRAMs are in self-refresh mode, XST_FAILURE if no DDRMCs are enabled in the design or no DRAMs are in self-refresh mode

inbodydescription.para:
DRAMs are in self-refresh, if:
At least one DDRMC is enabled in the design
All the active DRAMs are in self-refresh mode
